# Image attributions

## Status (2026-08-25)

`hero.jpg` and `ambiance2.jpg` are genuine Gemini generations as of
2026-08-25 (generated via the `gemini-image-generator` tool),
replacing a generic reused coffee/window stock photo shared across
several other posts. `ambiance1.jpg` (a real GitHub screenshot) and
`ambiance3.jpg` (the UCSD Geisel Library photo) were already
genuine.

- `hero.jpg`: three identical small wooden boxes stacked in a
  staggered row on a shelf, each a different size. Metaphor: a
  three-tier backup architecture.
- `ambiance2.jpg`: a single external hard drive resting on a desk
  beside a coiled cable and a small paper luggage tag. Metaphor:
  the offsite backup tier.

Both processed via `magick -resize 1600x -strip -quality 85` to
1600x873.
